title: Ubisoft plans to close Trials studio RedLynx 🏍️
subject: trials
description:
What's your favorite Trials game? 👇

Ubisoft plans to close RedLynx, the Helsinki studio behind the Trials series, affecting around 52 staff pending Finnish change negotiations. Ubisoft Singapore, lead studio on Skull and Bones, is cutting 70 jobs. Ubisoft said it recognizes "the impact this may have on our colleagues."

Sources: VGC (Oct 14, 2026), Game Developer (Oct 14, 2026), GamesIndustry.biz
Game footage © Ubisoft.

scenes.text: Ubisoft plans to close RedLynx, the studio behind Trials.
The Helsinki team, bought by Ubisoft in 2011, has around 52 staff and no current project.
Under Finnish law, the closure has to go through change negotiations first.
Ubisoft Singapore, the lead studio on Skull and Bones, is cutting 70 jobs as well.
RedLynx broke out with Trials HD on Xbox Live Arcade. Its last big release was Trials Rising in 2019.
In a statement, Ubisoft said it recognizes the impact on both teams.
